name: @composable-os/pdf
description: The platform's PDF writer (ADR 0645, generalised by stage 35, ADR 0737): a safe core of standard fonts and hex-string text, a table layout, and renderers for a signed agreement, a quote, an invoice, a credit note and a receipt, shared by the email gatekeeper and the host's downloads; and a cheap page estimate the host's core asks at publish. No dependencies.
